routes.name: Riverside Flats
routes.description: Fast and flat down the river valley, made for drafting and sprints.

routes.name: Rolling Hills
routes.description: From the hilltop café through the orchards and the valley, with one short climb back up.

routes.name: Col de la Forge
routes.description: Over the hills to the Forge Hut on the col, then a long, fast descent back to the valley.

routes.name: Balcony Road
routes.description: Up to the hilltop café, then west along the high road under the ridge, with views over the whole valley.

routes.name: Forge Circuit
routes.description: From the Forge Hut down the west side, back along the high road and up to the col again.

routes.name: Island Tour
routes.description: The long way round: the river valley, the col from the west, the high road and back down the west valley.

routes.name: Cape Loop
routes.description: Along the beaches of the south coast, over the low cliffs of the south-eastern cape and back by the valley and the western bays.
